effects.heading: Poison, Immolation, Freezing, Lightning Arrow
text: Makes those skills fire their special effect every 5 attacks instead of 3, but increases their total damage by 20% effect.

effects.heading: Strafe
text: Triples the number of targets, but applies a 2% physical resist penalty per arrow fired for 2 seconds. This effect has no limit.

effects.heading: Multiple Shot
text: Causes Multiple Shot to fire a nova of arrows instead but no longer gains damage bonus per level.

effects.heading: Tornado Shot
text: Fires a 16 arrow nova instead, triples its special synergy debuff, and gains an unmodifiable 10 seconds cooldown.

effects.heading: Legendary Arrow
text: No longer gains attack rating per level or from synergy, but the damage bonus is doubled.

effects.heading: Magic, Cold, Exploding Arrow
text: Those skills fire an extra arrow at a nearby enemy every 3 attacks, but lose all damage and attack rating from levels and synergies.

effects.heading: Spearstorm
text: Causes Spearstorm to double the number of spear shards every 3 attacks, but no longer grants bonus physical damage.

effects.heading: Fend
text: Causes Fend to generate only the small spear nova, which now reduces physical resist at 150% effectiveness, but no longer slows.

effects.heading: Dance of Death
text: Replaces converging novas with waves of homing spears.
Critical strikes are replaced by extra waves.

effects.heading: Spearstorm
text: Gains 2 times less spear shards per level, but the global physical damage is doubled.

effects.heading: Fend
text: Causes Fend to generate only the bigger spear nova and double the slow effectiveness.

effects.heading: Dance of Death
text: Doubles total damage every 5 attacks with the special synergy instead of a 15% chance to quadruple damage.

effects.heading: Pyre, Plague, Frost Javelin, Lightning Fury
text: Those skills fire 2 additional javelins every 3 throws, but total damage is reduced by 40%.

effects.heading: Dragon Blade
text: Halves the number of targets and strikes a nearby enemy roughly equal to 60% of the amount reduced.

effects.heading: Hatchet Flurry
text: No longer bounces. Instead releases a 4 axe converging nova that hits only the main target again.

effects.heading: Phantom Hatchets
text: Now launches the axes in a spiraling nova instead, which can only hit terrain and then ricochet towards up to 4 nearby enemies.

effects.heading: Stampede
text: Increases magical bolts number by 50%, but reduces target seek number from 2 to 1.

effects.heading: Berserk Fury
text: Magical bolts split towards nearby enemies instantly, but no longer generate converging novas. Increases projectile speed and number of bolts by 50%.

effects.heading: Wolves, Ravens, Grizzly
text: Halves the Wolves and Ravens you can summon and gain 1 additional grizzly bear for every 5 regular summons lost. Double the amount of hits of all pet skills and the damage dealt by contagion.

effects.heading: Undead Frenzy
text: This skill no longer grants elemental damage, but the physical damage is doubled.

effects.heading: Curses
text: All curses are twice as strong, but their duration is reduced to 2 seconds and radius to 4 yards.

masteries.label: Wretched Scythe

effects.heading: Magic Spells
text: Your Necromancer’s direct damage magic spells have a 1% chance to repeat per 1% missing life. Your magic resist is always 0.

mods: -100% Magic Resist (no item line; why your magic resist is always 0)

effects.heading: Zeal
text: Increases the total empower chance by 50%, but shortens the duration to 2 seconds.

effects.heading: Fanatic Swing
text: Reduces the number of hits to 1, but every third hit now unleashes elemental effects that deal spell damage, scaling with all direct damage spells of their respective element.

effects.heading: Sorceress Spells
text: Triples the cooldown of your level 24 Sorceress spells and adds a 2 second cooldown to Hydra, but increases your total spell damage by 20%.

effects.heading: Sorceress Exclusives
text: Increases the bonuses granted by your exclusives by 50% and their downsides by 75%.

effects.heading: Elemental Charge-up Skills
text: Makes all elemental charge up skills discharge only the corresponding charge, but increase total damage by 50/70/100% for each charge level, respectively.
This effect does not affect procs and does not stack.

effects.heading: Elemental Charge-up Skills
text: Lowers the base damage of all elemental charge up skills by 25%, but each different charge present increases the total damage by 10%.
This effect stacks.

effects.heading: Black Magic
text: Now provides total attack damage instead of total spell damage and attacking steadily increases the attack damage bonus.

effects.heading: Fire and Magic Skills
text: Hellfire Lance, Flame Wave, Seeking Flames and Apocalypse deal lightning damage instead.
Miasma Bolt, Miasma Chains and Abyss deal cold damage instead.
